_meta.title: Component catalog
_meta.purpose: UI components by category with variant/state/token anatomy. Loom's available-components reference — projects cherry-pick via a manifest; only picked components get built. Use-agnostic (grouped by what they are, not where used).
_meta.sources: Distilled from Material Design 3, Shadcn/Radix, Apple HIG, Vercel. Live fetch endpoints for component source: registries.md (same folder).
_meta.consumedBy: Loom catalog + per-project picker. Reconcile against CATALOG_AUDIT.md (the actually-generated atoms) during the catalog overhaul.
_meta.movedFrom: knowledge/design/components.md — converted to JSON + relocated to loom 2026-06-03 (it's catalog substrate, not general design reference).

categories.name: Actions
categories.description: Trigger operations or represent user choices.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Semantic variant model — variant implies color, no outline/ghost appearances. Icon slot (leading/trailing). Loading replaces label with spinner. Touch target min 44px regardless of visual size.

components.name: Icon Button
components.notes: Ghost is default — icon buttons frequently serve structural/dismiss actions (dialog close, toast dismiss). Always requires aria-label. Touch-target padding when visual size < 44px. Composable inside dialogs, alerts, toasts, cards.

components.name: FAB (Floating Action Button)
components.notes: One per screen. Extended preferred over icon-only for clarity. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Chip
components.notes: Horizontal scroll or flow layout, never vertical stacks. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Toggle / Switch
components.notes: Switch for binary settings. Toggle group for multi-option single/multi select.

components.name: Textarea
components.notes: Min/max height. Character count optional.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Native select for simple cases (better mobile UX). Custom only when needed for styling or multi-select.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: Label and control share single hit target. Group with fieldset/legend.

components.name: Radio Group
components.notes: Always in groups. Group with fieldset/legend.

components.name: Combobox / Autocomplete
components.notes: Combines text input with dropdown. Keyboard navigation required (arrows, enter, escape).

components.name: Date Picker
components.notes: Consider native input type=date for simple cases. Calendar grid needs full keyboard navigation.

components.name: Slider
components.notes: Always pair with visible value label. Touch target on thumb min 44px.

components.name: File Upload
components.notes: Show file type/size constraints. Preview for images. Progress indicator during upload.

components.name: Input OTP
components.notes: Auto-advance on digit entry. Paste support required. (Vercel/Shadcn)

components.name: Card
components.notes: Can be interactive (clickable) or static. Interactive cards need hover/focus states and keyboard activation.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Container fill pattern for categorization labels. Keep labels short (1-2 words or a number).

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: Always include alt text for image variant. Group as overlapping stack for multi-user display.

components.name: Stat
components.notes: Use tabular-nums for value alignment. Trend indicator needs color + icon (not color alone).

components.name: Progress Bar
components.notes: Include accessible label (aria-label or visible text). Announce completion via aria-live.

components.name: Skeleton
components.notes: Match the shape/size of the content being loaded. Animate with subtle pulse.

components.name: Chart
components.notes: Legends required. Accessible colors (distinguishable without color — patterns or labels). Responsive reflow. Tabular alternative for screen readers.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Virtualize for large datasets (50+ rows). Horizontal scroll wrapper for overflow, not page scroll. Sticky header for long tables.

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: Triggered by hover AND focus. ~300ms delay. Dismiss on escape. Never put essential info in tooltips.

components.name: Empty State
components.notes: Always provide a next action when possible. Don't leave the user staring at nothing.

components.name: Kbd
components.notes: Display platform-appropriate modifier keys (Cmd vs Ctrl).

components.name: Dialog / Modal
components.notes: Focus trap required. Return focus on close. Escape to dismiss (non-alert). Reserve for critical interruptions. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Toast / Snackbar
components.notes: Auto-dismiss (5-10s). Single action max. Stack when multiple. Position above bottom nav, below FAB. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Alert / Banner
components.notes: Inline in page flow, not overlaid. Icon + text (not color alone). Persistent until dismissed or resolved.

components.name: Sheet / Drawer
components.notes: Drag handle required for bottom sheet. Escape/scrim click to dismiss modal variant. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Top Bar / App Bar
components.notes: 2-3 action icons max, overflow menu for the rest. Scroll behavior (collapse, elevate, hide) depends on content. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Sidebar / Nav Rail
components.notes: Rail for medium screens (600-839dp), permanent sidebar for expanded (840dp+). Active state via aria-current. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.notes: 3-5 destinations only. Always include labels — never icon-only. (Material Design 3)

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.notes: Use aria-label=Breadcrumb on nav. Current page marked with aria-current=page.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: One tab active at a time. Full keyboard navigation (arrows between tabs). Content panel linked via aria-controls.

components.name: Command Palette
components.notes: Keyboard-first (Cmd+K trigger). Fuzzy matching. Recent items. Escape to close.

components.name: Pagination
components.notes: Current page via aria-current=page. Include Page X of Y for screen readers.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.notes: Full keyboard navigation. Escape closes submenus. Menu items vs. menu links distinction.

components.name: Popover
components.notes: Close on outside click and escape. Anchor positioning (flip/shift to stay in viewport).

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.notes: Full keyboard navigation (arrows, type-ahead, enter, escape). Anchor positioning.

components.name: Accordion
components.notes: Use details/summary for simple cases. Keyboard: enter/space to toggle.

components.name: Separator
components.notes: Decorative role — use role=separator or semantic hr.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.notes: Custom scrollbar styling. Maintain native behavior. overscroll-behavior: contain in nested scroll areas.

components.name: Resizable
components.notes: Minimum pane sizes. Keyboard-operable handle (arrows to resize). Double-click to reset.

components.name: Stepper
components.notes: Each step independently validatable. Back navigation should preserve state.

components.name: Carousel
components.notes: Use CSS scroll-snap. Keyboard navigation (arrows). Pause auto-play on hover/focus. Accessible labels for slides and controls.

components.name: Tree View
components.notes: Full keyboard navigation (arrows expand/collapse/navigate, enter to select). aria-expanded on parent nodes.

components.name: Color Picker
components.notes: Must support keyboard input (not just pointer). Show selected color preview. Allow hex/rgb manual entry.
